notes.title: Finally Free
notes.content:
FEWAR-DVD is now free to play!

We are aware of some bugs with the game, but it will not be updated going forward. Sorry for any inconvenience caused by lost runs. Hopefully this will not bother people if the game is free.

Thank you to everyone who purchased the game, and those that play it in the future ❤️


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592968/2476447ea3792191413757397bf308aa5538014c.png[/img]

notes.title: Leaderboards!
notes.content:
FEWAR_DVD now has a leaderboard. Compete for the highest score!

There's also a new song for the final area from Lewmoth, and support for controller rumble.

Also, many bugs were fixed, thank you for the reports through the forums.

Make sure to leave a review if you haven't already! It's a huge help for the game.
